title: Agent Authority Boundary Lab
summary: Trace an allowed read, a denied write, and an authorized replay through a deterministic tool boundary.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+ and a terminal. Docker Compose is optional.
cases: A reader requests a read. Does the executor run?
Allow. The executor returns the fixture. Zero writes.
A reader requests a write. Does the executor run?
Deny. The executor is never called. Zero writes.
A writer delivers the same authorized write twice. How many writes occur?
One. The first delivery writes and the second is recognized as a replay.
